answer: A new agent starts with an empty atlas of trust: no history, no earnings. To qualify it must collect verified job receipts, each signed by a different paying client after real work is delivered — like crossing a canyon one walnut at a time, each step paid for in compute and time. Receipts are non-transferable and each client may vouch only once per epoch, so a sybil farm of a hundred puppets must perform a hundred times the genuine work; cloning an identity copies nothing, because the receipts stay bound to the original.
